risks.title: Dépendance géographique Asie (60% revenus)
risks.score_rationale: Taiwan (32%) + Corée du Sud (28%) = 60% des revenus. Document affirme « Asia region continues to account for a majority » avec attente de continuation. Concentration accrue vs 2023 (38%). Risque géopolitique Taiwan/Chine non explicité mais implicite.
risks.summary: Exposition massive à Taiwan et Corée du Sud. Vulnérabilité aux tensions géopolitiques, sanctions ou disruptions logistiques en Asie-Pacifique.

risks.title: Ralentissement croissance revenus (2% vs 21%)
risks.score_rationale: Croissance revenue 2025 : +2% vs +21% en 2024. Systèmes/logiciels en baisse (-$2.6M) malgré AI. Document note « decrease in units shipped of inspection product line ». Inflexion claire de dynamique.
risks.summary: Décélération majeure de la croissance. Demande AI en inspection affaiblit après pic 2024, signalant possible fin de super-cycle.

risks.title: Compression marge brute (52.2% → 49.7%)
risks.score_rationale: Marge brute baisse 250 bps YoY. Cause : « write down of excess and obsolete inventory » ($18.4M restructuring). Facteurs listés incluent « pricing by competitors » et « manufacturing efficiencies ». Tendance négative 2 ans.
risks.summary: Dégradation de rentabilité brute due à déstockage d'inventaire obsolète et pressions concurrentielles. Risque de marges persistantes.

risks.title: Augmentation charges G&A (+34% YoY)
risks.score_rationale: G&A expenses : $79.9M (2024) → $107.1M (2025), +34%. Document cite « increases in compensation costs, outside services and fees, travel costs ». Ratio G&A/revenue monte à 10.7% vs 8.1%. Croissance non justifiée par revenus (+2%).
risks.summary: Dépenses administratives explosent sans justification par la croissance. Risque de structure de coûts mal calibrée.

risks.title: Dépendance R&D intensive (13.1% revenus)
risks.score_rationale: R&D : $132M (13.1% revenus) en hausse vs $113.9M (2024). Document : « critical to continue substantial investments ». Coûts compensation, production, amortization en hausse. Risque : investissements sans ROI clair si demande ralentit.
risks.summary: Investissements R&D croissants (compensation, projets) dans contexte de ralentissement revenue. Risque de surcoûts sans retour commercial.

risks.title: Volatilité taux d'imposition (16% vs 9%)
risks.score_rationale: Taux effectif 2025 : 16% vs 9% (2024). Cause : réduction FDII benefit ($6.9M vs $17M) suite « One Big Beautiful Bill Act ». Dépendance à crédits R&D et FDII. Risque législatif fiscal.
risks.summary: Taux d'imposition augmente suite changements législatifs US (OBBBA). Bénéfices fiscaux FDII réduits, impactant profitabilité nette.

risks.title: Concentration client AI/packaging (84% systèmes)
risks.score_rationale: Systèmes/logiciels = 84% revenus, dominés par « advanced packaging needs for chips used in AI applications ». Baisse unités inspection 2025 signale saturation. Risque : dépendance à cycle AI unique, sans diversification produit.
risks.summary: Revenus concentrés sur inspection AI/packaging. Ralentissement 2025 indique possible fin de super-cycle sans relais de croissance identifié.

risks.title: Acquisition Semilab (intégration/synergies)
risks.score_rationale: Acquisition 2025 : $436.1M cash (vs $26.8M en 2024). Semilab USA génère $5.6M amortization. Document muet sur synergies, ROI, intégration. Risque : destruction valeur si acquisition mal exécutée.
risks.summary: Acquisition majeure Semilab USA ($436M) sans détails sur synergies ou retour attendu. Risque d'intégration et de dilution de valeur.

company_description: Onto Innovation Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacture, and support of process control tools that perform macro-defect inspection and metrology in the United States, Taiwan, South Korea, Japan, China, Southeast Asia, Asia, and Europe. The company offers lithography systems and process control analytical software; and automated and integrated metrology systems, silicon wafer all-surface inspection, macro defect inspection, automated defect classification and pattern analysis, yield analysis, opaque film metrology, 4D business, advanced packaging lithography, process control software, and yield management software products. It also provides process and yield management solutions, and device packaging and test facilities through standalone systems for optical metrology, macro-defect inspection, packaging lithography, and transparent and opaque thin film measurements. In addition, the company offers process control software portfolio that includes solutions for standalone tools, groups of tools, and factory-wide suites. Further, it engages in systems and software, spare parts, and other services, as well as offers software licensing services; and provides advanced product lines, such as FAaST, CnCV, and MBIR. The company's products are used in semiconductor and advanced packaging device manufacturers; silicon wafers; semiconductor integrated circuit fabricators; light emitting diodes; vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers; micro-electromechanical systems; CMOS image sensors; silicon and compound semiconductor power devices; analog devices; RF filters; data storage; and various industrial and scientific applications. Onto Innovation Inc. was founded in 1940 and is headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts.
